title: Lead to opened contract — every hand-off, every number carried over

steps.do: [Test MktExec] New lead "TB Ports Ltd", value ₹6,00,000.
steps.observed: Lead TB Ports Ltd, ₹6,00,000, at the first stage "New enquiry".

steps.do: [Test MktExec] Log a contact; move to Qualified → Proposal sent.
steps.observed: Moves offered: Contact made, Qualified, Won — customer →, Not pursued. Moved to Qualified — History shows "Qualified" (stage history: Qualified). The Inspection profile's lead pipeline (New enquiry → Contact made → Qualified → Won — customer / Not pursued) has no "Proposal sent" stage; the quotation itself is the proposal step.
steps.suggest: [Test MktExec] Log a contact; move to Qualified. → History shows the contact and the move.

steps.do: [Test MktExec] Won → Convert (new customer, State Gujarat).
steps.expect: Customer + enquiry created; enquiry assigned to you, branch Ahmedabad.
steps.observed: "Done — TB Ports Ltd is now a customer, and an inquiry is raised for what they want. The in" — customer created; enquiry INQ-00001 assigned to Test MktExec, branch Ahmedabad.

steps.do: [Test BDM] Open a deal for TB Ports Ltd, value ₹6,00,000; create a quotation from the deal.
steps.expect: Draft quotation linked to the deal.
steps.observed: Draft Q-00001 created from the deal and linked to it.

steps.do: [Test BDM] Lines 60 Man-day × ₹10,000 = ₹6,00,000 subtotal; GST 18% = ₹1,08,000; total ₹7,08,000.

steps.expect: Chain: Level 2 (Marketing Manager) because ₹6,00,000 is above ₹5,00,000 before tax.
steps.observed: "Submitted for approval — 2 step(s). Now with Test BranchMgr (Branch Manager); then, last, level 2: Test MktMgr (Marketing Manager)." Chain: Level 1 BRANCH_MANAGER → Level 2 MARKETING_MANAGER — since 24 Oct 2026 a quotation is signed by the level its value falls in AND every level below it (docs/03, 19n).
steps.suggest: Chain: Level 1 (Branch Manager), then Level 2 (Marketing Manager) — ₹6,00,000 is above ₹5,00,000 before tax, so it climbs through both levels.

steps.observed: Approved — Test BranchMgr (ticked 5/5): "Your approval is recorded. Now with Test MktMgr (Marketing Manager)."; Test MktMgr: "All approvals complete — quote approved and ready to send."
steps.note: The copy's checklist has 5 points, so it reads 5/5, not 7/7.

steps.observed: "Marked sent and follow-ups scheduled; no customer e-mail on " — 5 follow-ups scheduled.

steps.expect: Accepted. Deal → Won. Lead → Won — customer.
steps.observed: Accepted; deal WON; lead "Won — customer Won — customer 🎉 Won — TB Ports Lt" (CONVERTED).

steps.do: [Test Finance] Register the contract & request opening.
steps.observed: Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00001 is Pending, but its value is ₹7,08,000 — the total WITH GST — not ₹6,00,000 before tax

steps.do: [Test OpsMgr] Give the first signature. [Test BranchMgr] Approve & open the contract.
steps.expect: Contract OPEN; order floated to Operations.
steps.observed: "Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00001 opened and floated to operations."

steps.do: [Test Coord] Left menu → Operations → work orders.
steps.expect: A work order can be raised under this contract number with the customer, sites and lines carried over — nothing retyped.
steps.observed: Operations → raise: the form for AHM/C/2026-27/00001 carries TB Ports Ltd, the accepted quotation and contract number, and offers the line "Crane inspection" to draw on — nothing retyped. (The quotation had no site, so none to carry.)

steps.expect: Won value includes ₹6,00,000; Test BDM credited.
steps.observed: Sales dashboard shows the ₹6 L win and credits Test BDM.
